applies_to: Belimo 6-way pressure-independent zone valves C615QP-B/D/F+BAC and C620QPT-G+BAC, application 6-Way-PIQCV V1.0, on BACnet MS/TP.
summary: This 6-way zone valve switches one coil between a heating and a cooling circuit and limits flow in each sequence. A single setpoint AO 1 covers both: 0-33 % runs sequence 1 from Vmax1 down to zero, 67-100 % runs sequence 2 from zero up to Vmax2, and the middle is a dead band. It reports position, calculated flow, the active sequence and an actuator status. It is a different product from the 6-way EPIV.
notes: Flow values are calculated, not measured by a sensor.
MV 121 sets the unit for AI 19, AI 109 and AV 119; default l/h.
Minimum Vmax depends on the valve size (19-28 % of Vnom).
MV 100 ControlMode is read-only and fixed at FlowCtrl.

integration.summary: Write MV 122 SpSource = Bus, set Vmax1 and Vmax2 once, then command AO 1 using the split range (0-33 % sequence 1, 67-100 % sequence 2). Read MI 1 for the active sequence, AI 19 for flow and BI 101 for alarms.

minimum_points.name: SpRel
minimum_points.why: Single setpoint for both heating/cooling sequences

minimum_points.name: SpSource
minimum_points.why: Must be Bus for AO 1 to take effect

integration.enable: Write MV 122 SpSource = 2 (Bus). With Analog (the default) the valve follows the 0-10 V signal on wire 3.
setup: MS/TP only: baud 9600-115200, default 38400; address 0-127, default 1.
Max 32 nodes without repeater; the 120 Ω terminating resistor must be fitted externally.
Configured with the Belimo Assistant App.
gotchas: Writable objects with instance 90 and above are persistent; don't write them on a regular basis.
Setpoints between 33 and 67 % are a dead band with no flow.
